narrationTexts: I'll start by finding the remaining call sites.
finalText:
**Migration done in 12 files, 36 call sites.** All parse clean under `node --check`.

Left alone on purpose:

| What | Why |
|---|---|
| `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` 2 sites | Header says do not edit, replaced on upgrade |
| `cache.query(...)` ~20 sites | Different object, not `db` |

Next: ask the legacy-orm upstream to move, or wrap the vendor calls.
